translations.web: Yahweh’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.
translations.bsb: The presence of the LORD has scattered them; He regards them no more. The priests are shown no honor; the elders find no favor.
translations.kjv: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
translations.asv: The anger of Jehovah hath scattered them; he will no more regard them: They respected not the persons of the priests, they favored not the elders.
